name: orchy
description: Multi-agent coding orchestration for VS Code — a terminal grid of isolated agents, driven by an orchestrator, with live topology.

orchy.baseBranch.description: Branch that agent worktrees are created from and merged back into.

orchy.visibleSlots.description: How many agent terminals are visible in the editor grid at once. Sessions beyond this run detached.

orchy.autoPromoteOnBlocked.description: When a session needs input, bring its terminal into a visible grid slot. Never steals focus.
